description: Two humans are talking near the device; the audio is conversational but the speech is not addressed to the agent. The speak policy must produce silence — NOT a full_response or backchannel — because the utterance is classified as not addressed to the agent. This tests the invariant that proactive speech requires policy approval (invariant #4) and that silence wins ties (invariant #8) when addressee confidence is below threshold.

fixture_conventions.sub_cases: Two sub-cases: 'blocking' (social_mode in _BLOCKING_SOCIAL_MODES) and 'non_blocking' (social_mode not in _BLOCKING_SOCIAL_MODES, EOU confirmed, agent addressed).
fixture_conventions.frame_split: Frames 000-002 are sub-case 'blocking' (social_mode=user_addressing_other). Frames 100-102 are sub-case 'non_blocking' (social_mode=user_addressing_agent, eou_probability=0.9, user_addressed_agent=true).
fixture_conventions.blocking_design: social_mode=user_addressing_other is in _BLOCKING_SOCIAL_MODES; decide() returns silence/NOT_ADDRESSED_TO_AGENT at hard-block step 1, before any EOU or budget checks.
fixture_conventions.non_blocking_design: social_mode=user_addressing_agent is NOT in _BLOCKING_SOCIAL_MODES; decide() proceeds past step 1. With eou_probability=0.9 and user_addressed_agent=true, the policy reaches step 9 and returns full_response/EOU_CONFIRMED. This is the load-bearing negative sub-case confirming the social_mode gate does not over-block.
fixture_conventions.expected_events_markers: event_type strings are fixture-internal role labels, not Part 5 event_type values.
